AddResolverEndpoint.description_en: You can call this operation to add an endpoint

AddZone.description_en: Call the AddZone operation to create a built-in authoritative zone. The built-in authoritative zone can be a standard zone or an accelerated zone
AddZone.description_zh: 调用AddZone创建内置权威域名，内置权威域名可以添加在普通区或加速区

AddZoneRecord.description_en: Call the AddZoneRecord operation to add a DNS record to an authoritative zone. Within the effective scope of the zone, the internal DNS record for a domain name overwrites its public DNS record
AddZoneRecord.description_zh: 调用AddZoneRecord添加内置权威解析记录。在解析生效范围内，该域名的内网解析记录会覆盖其公网解析记录

BindResolverRuleVpc.description_en: The BindResolverRuleVpc operation associates a forwarding rule with a virtual private cloud (VPC)
BindResolverRuleVpc.description_zh: 调用BindResolverRuleVpc设置转发规则关联VPC

BindZoneVpc.description_en: Binds a Zone to, or unbinds it from, one or more VPCs to define its effective scope
BindZoneVpc.description_zh: 绑定或者解绑zone与VPC列表两者之间的关系，设置域名（zone）生效范围

ChangeZoneDnsGroup.description_en: Modify the location of a ZONE

CheckZoneName.description_en: You can call the CheckZoneName operation to check whether a zone name is available
CheckZoneName.description_zh: 调用CheckZoneName根据规则校验zone名称是否可添加

DeleteResolverEndpoint.description_en: You can call the DeleteResolverEndpoint operation to delete an endpoint by its ID
DeleteResolverEndpoint.description_zh: 调用DeleteResolverEndpoint根据终端节点ID删除终端节点

DeleteResolverRule.description_en: Deletes a forwarding rule by its ID
DeleteResolverRule.description_zh: 调用DeleteResolverRule根据转发规则ID删除转发规则

DeleteUserVpcAuthorization.description_en: Deletes a cross-account authorization based on a specified account ID and authorization type
DeleteUserVpcAuthorization.description_zh: 调用DeleteUserVpcAuthorization删除跨账号授权，可以根据账号ID和授权类型删除

DeleteZone.description_en: Deletes an idle zone (built-in authoritative domain name)
DeleteZone.description_zh: 调用DeleteZone删除一个空闲的内置权威域名（Zone）

DeleteZoneRecord.description_en: The DeleteZoneRecord operation deletes a DNS record by its ID
DeleteZoneRecord.description_zh: 调用DeleteZoneRecord根据解析记录ID删除解析记录

DescribeChangeLogs.description_en: You can call the DescribeChangeLogs operation to retrieve the operation logs for a private zone. The logs record operations related to built-in authoritative zones, cache management, forwarding management, endpoints, and DNS record queries. You can perform a fuzzy search by keywords such as behavior and content
DescribeChangeLogs.description_zh: 调用DescribeChangeLogs接口获取内网DNS解析操作日志。操作日志是记录内置权威、缓存管理、转发管理、服务地址以及查询解析记录的操作日志，可以根据行为、内容等关键字进行模糊查询

DescribeCustomLineInfo.description_en: Retrieves the details of a custom line
DescribeCustomLineInfo.description_zh: 查询自定义线路详细信息

DescribeCustomLines.description_en: Queries a list of custom lines

DescribeIntranetUserCanAnalysisVpcs.description_en: Retrieves a list of VPCs that a user can analyze
DescribeIntranetUserCanAnalysisVpcs.description_zh: 获取用户可以分析的VPC列表

DescribePvtzStatisticsGlobalOverview.description_en: Queries the global overview of DNS resolution statistics for Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone
DescribePvtzStatisticsGlobalOverview.description_zh: Pvtz解析统计信息全局总览

DescribePvtzStatisticsHistory.description_en: Queries the trend of Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone parse statistics information

DescribePvtzStatisticsSummary.description_en: Queries the summary list of Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone parse statistics information
DescribePvtzStatisticsSummary.description_zh: Pvtz解析统计信息摘要列表

DescribePvtzStatisticsZoneOverview.description_en: Queries the overview of DNS parse statistics information at the zone dimension for Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone
DescribePvtzStatisticsZoneOverview.description_zh: Pvtz解析统计信息Zone维度总览

DescribeRegions.description_en: Call the DescribeRegions operation to query a list of available regions. You can filter the list by criteria such as the scenario and VPC type
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 调用DescribeRegions接口获取可用地域列表供用户选择，可根据场景信息、vpc类型等进行筛选

DescribeRequestGraph.description_en: Queries details about the number of requests based on conditions such as a time range
DescribeRequestGraph.description_zh: 调用DescribeRequestGraph，根据时间范围等条件查询请求量详情

DescribeResolverAvailableZones.description_en: Call DescribeResolverAvailableZones to retrieve a list of available zones
DescribeResolverAvailableZones.description_zh: 调用DescribeResolverAvailableZones获取可用区域列表

DescribeResolverEndpoint.description_en: You can call DescribeResolverEndpoint to retrieve the details of an endpoint by its ID
DescribeResolverEndpoint.description_zh: 调用DescribeResolverEndpoint根据终端节点ID获取终端节点详情

DescribeResolverEndpoints.description_en: You can call DescribeResolverEndpoints to retrieve a list of endpoints
DescribeResolverEndpoints.description_zh: 调用DescribeResolverEndpoints获取终端节点列表

DescribeResolverRule.description_en: Call the DescribeResolverRule operation to retrieve the details of a forwarding rule
DescribeResolverRule.description_zh: 调用DescribeResolverRule根据转发规则ID获取转发规则详情

DescribeResolverRules.description_en: Describes one or more forwarding rules

DescribeStatisticSummary.description_en: Call the DescribeStatisticSummary operation to retrieve a summary of yesterday's request volume. This summary includes the top three zones and top three VPCs ranked by request volume
DescribeStatisticSummary.description_zh: 调用DescribeStatisticSummary获取昨请求量概要，包括Zone请求量Top3信息和VPC请求量Top3信息

DescribeSyncEcsHostTask.description_en: Call DescribeSyncEcsHostTask to retrieve the details of a hostname sync task based on a zone ID
DescribeSyncEcsHostTask.description_zh: 调用DescribeSyncEcsHostTask根据域名ID获取主机名同步任务详情

DescribeTags.description_en: Queries the tags that are added to resources in PrivateZone
DescribeTags.description_zh: 调用DescribeTags查询内网DNS解析（PrivateZone）资源的标签列表

DescribeUserServiceStatus.description_en: Queries the service status of the current user, which indicates whether the service is activated or has overdue payments
DescribeUserServiceStatus.description_zh: 查询当前用户的服务状态，例如是否开通服务，是否欠费等

DescribeUserVpcAuthorizations.description_en: Call the DescribeUserVpcAuthorizations operation to retrieve a list of cross-account authorizations
DescribeUserVpcAuthorizations.description_zh: 调用DescribeUserVpcAuthorizations获取跨账号授权列表

DescribeZoneInfo.description_en: Call the DescribeZoneInfo operation to retrieve the details of a specified built-in authoritative zone. The details include the list of VPCs that are bound to the zone
DescribeZoneInfo.description_zh: 调用DescribeZoneInfo获取指定内置权威域名（Zone）的详细信息，包括当前Zone绑定的VPC列表信息等

DescribeZoneRecord.description_en: Queries the details of a DNS record

DescribeZoneRecords.description_en: You can call DescribeZoneRecords to query DNS records for a zone
DescribeZoneRecords.description_zh: 调用DescribeZoneRecords查询域名解析记录列表

DescribeZoneVpcTree.description_en: Call the DescribeZoneVpcTree operation to query the zones and the Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) attached to them in your account
DescribeZoneVpcTree.description_zh: 调用DescribeZoneVpcTree获取当前账号下Zone 列表及其绑定的 VPC 列表

DescribeZones.description_en: You can call the DescribeZones operation to query a list of zones available to your account
DescribeZones.description_zh: 调用DescribeZones查询当前用户的Zone列表

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags that are added to resources in Private Zone
ListTagResources.description_zh: 调用ListTagResources查询内网DNS解析（PrivateZone）资源标签关系列表

MoveResourceGroup.description_en: You can call the MoveResourceGroup operation to move a resource to a different resource group

SearchCustomLines.description_en: Searches for custom access control lists (ACLs)

SetProxyPattern.description_en: Sets the recursive resolution proxy for subdomains
SetProxyPattern.description_zh: 调用SetProxyPattern设置子域名递归解析代理

SetZoneRecordStatus.description_en: You can call SetZoneRecordStatus to set the status of a DNS record for a zone. This enables or pauses DNS resolution
SetZoneRecordStatus.description_zh: 调用SetZoneRecordStatus设置域名（Zone）析记录状态，启用或暂停解析

TagResources.description_en: You can call the TagResources operation to add or modify tags for one or more zones in a batch
TagResources.description_zh: 调用TagResources标记内网DNS解析（PrivateZone）资源，批量增加或修改资源Zone的标签信息

UntagResources.description_en: You can call the UntagResources operation to remove tags from one or more zones in PrivateZone
UntagResources.description_zh: 调用UntagResources取消内网DNS解析（PrivateZone）标记资源，批量删除Zone标签信息

UpdateRecordRemark.description_en: You can call the UpdateRecordRemark operation to modify the remarks of a DNS record based on its ID
UpdateRecordRemark.description_zh: 调用UpdateRecordRemark根据解析记录ID修改解析记录的备注信息

UpdateSyncEcsHostTask.description_en: Call the UpdateSyncEcsHostTask operation to add or update a hostname sync task
UpdateSyncEcsHostTask.description_zh: 调用UpdateSyncEcsHostTask新增或更新主机名同步任务

UpdateZoneRecord.description_en: The UpdateZoneRecord operation modifies a DNS record for a zone. You can change properties such as the host record, record type, and weight
UpdateZoneRecord.description_zh: 调用UpdateZoneRecord修改域名（Zone）的解析记录，包括主机记录、解析记录、权重等

UpdateZoneRecordWeight.description_en: Updates the weight value of an authoritative DNS record in Alibaba Cloud DNS PrivateZone
UpdateZoneRecordWeight.description_zh: 更新Private Zone内网权威记录权重值

UpdateZoneRemark.description_en: Modifies the remark for a built-in authoritative domain name (zone)
UpdateZoneRemark.description_zh: 调用UpdateZoneRemark修改内置权威域名（zone）的备注信息
